label: Political Prisoners
contestNote: Foro Penal counted 344 political prisoners as of September 14 (330 men, 14 women; 200 civilians, 144 military; 153 convicted, 191 without conviction; 32 foreign nationals) — down from 391 in late August, with 7 releases and 23 newly added to the list over the period. That release brought total releases since Maduro's January 3 detention to roughly 1,046+ per government/opposition tallies. US Secretary of State Rubio has called prisoner releases 'a crucial step' for reconciliation; opposition figures continue to demand all remaining prisoners be freed 'without exception, without delay.'
delta: −47 vs Aug 26 (391); 344 still detained per Foro Penal

label: Earthquake Death Toll (Jun 24 quakes)
contestNote: USGS PAGER modeling initially projected a potential toll above 10,000; a UN estimate put ~50,000 people still missing as of late July; only 28.61% of debris had been cleared as of Aug 25, according to Rodríguez; government figures are self-reported without independent verification. Only 335 of the 4,000 promised replacement homes had been delivered as of mid-August, and an August 22 flash flood — unrelated to the earthquakes but striking the same recovering region — killed one more person and left six missing.
